press_references.value: Inkeep Launches Agent Builder For Customer Experience, Go-To-Market and Operations Teams

product_launches.description: Inkeep launched Agent Builder, an AI agent development platform that syncs a TypeScript SDK with a drag-and-drop visual editor to let developers and non-technical teams collaboratively build and deploy AI chat assistants and workflows.

overview_description.description:
Inkeep is a platform to ship AI Agents for customer experience, go-to-market, and operations teams.

Inkeep Agents are deployed at scale today with leading companies like Anthropic, Midjourney, Clay, and PostHog.

With Inkeep, teams get an intuitive drag-and-drop visual agent builder while engineers get a developer SDK with all the code-based tools they expect. Agents can be edited in either format with full 2-way sync, so engineering and non-technical teams can collaborate.
